name: n2
description: Tableau de bord local : sprint Jira, PR GitHub, veille des librairies, Sentry et CloudWatch

scripts.setup: chmod +x .githooks/pre-commit scripts/*.sh && git config core.hooksPath .githooks && (test -f config.local.json || cp config.example.json config.local.json) && chmod 600 config.local.json && bun run i18n && bunx panda codegen --silent && echo '→ Remplis config.local.json puis lance bun run dev'
scripts.demo: panda codegen --silent && N2_DEMO=1 N2_PORT=${N2_PORT:-4848} vite dev
scripts.typecheck: bun run i18n && panda codegen --silent && tsc -p .
scripts.start: panda codegen --silent && vite build && vite preview
scripts.test: bun run i18n && panda codegen --silent && vitest run
scripts.test:e2e: bun run i18n && panda codegen --silent && playwright test
